scripts.build: npm run sync:schemas && npm --workspace @invisra/printspec run build
scripts.test: npm run sync:schemas && npm run test:ts && npm run smoke:browser-import-graph
scripts.test:python: npm run sync:schemas && pytest tests/python tests/schema
scripts.test:schema: npm run sync:schemas && python -m pytest tests/schema
scripts.pack:ts: npm run sync:schemas && npm --workspace @invisra/printspec run build && npm --workspace @invisra/printspec pack --dry-run
scripts.smoke:npm: npm run sync:schemas && npm --workspace @invisra/printspec run build && npm run check:npm-package && node scripts/npm-smoke-test.mjs
scripts.release:node: npm run sync:schemas && npm run check:versions && npm run build && npm test && npm run check:npm-package && npm run smoke:npm
scripts.release:all: npm run release:node && npm run release:python
